messages.subject: Gunkul | Renewable expansion, strategic partnerships and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Gunkul Executive Leadership Team,

Gunkul's continued renewable expansion, including new power agreements and strategic partnership activity in 2026, makes the company an especially relevant target for my experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My role combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

I bring direct experience around a large solar and battery-storage transition, carbon-data governance, regulator coordination and community-sensitive execution. I also work across technical and corporate teams to convert external commitments into owners, timelines and evidence. This operating discipline would translate well into a fast-growing renewable platform.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles in External Affairs, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Government Relations or country strategy. I have attached a Gunkul-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
